```{css}
.gallery-wrapper {
display: flex;
overflow-x: auto;
scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
gap: 16px;
padding: 16px;
background: #f4f4f4;
-web-kit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.gallery-card {
flex: 0 0 auto;
width: 280px;
height: 200px;
scroll-snap-align: start;
position: relative;
border-radius: 8px;
overflow: hidden;
box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0.15)
}

.gallery-card img {
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
object-fit: cover;
display: block;
}

.gallery-caption {
position: absolute;
bottom: 0;
left: 0;
right: 0;
padding: 8px 10px;
background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0.7), rgba(0,0,0));
color: white;
font-size: 0.9em;
font-family: sans-serif;
}
```
yo

```{r build-gallery!}
gallery_data <- data.frame(
  src =paste0("https://cdn.hackaday.io/images/3386621752496019850.jpg", 1:8, "/600/450"),
  caption =paste("Site", 1:8, "-Sample Sponge Photo"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

gallery_cards <-pmap(gallery_data, functions(src, caption){
  tags$div(
    class = "gallery-card",
    tags$img(src = src, alt = caption),
    tags$div(class = "gallery-caption", caption)
  )
})

gallery <- tags$div(class = "gallery-wrapper", gallery_cards)

browsable(gallery)
```
